signal_state_machine.fib_state: fibLow/fibHigh initialized from first bar in the frozen data-start policy and monotonically updated by min(low)/max(high)
signal_state_machine.wt_state: WT1/WT2 updated causally from completed bars only
signal_state_machine.rsi_state: RSI updated causally from completed closes only
signal_state_machine.buy_event: WT1 crosses above WT2 on completed bar AND RSI<30 AND close<fib38
signal_state_machine.sell_event: WT1 crosses below WT2 on completed bar AND RSI>70 AND close>fib618
signal_state_machine.fill: next executable quote after signal bar close

dedupe_rules: Do not enumerate algebraically redundant Fibonacci conjuncts.
Do not count parameter-window variations as new genealogies.
BUY and SELL are separate signal sides but not separate source genealogies.
Management variants do not establish independent alpha.
required_before_config_hash_freeze: freeze exact EMA/SMA/RSI builtin seeding/warmup semantics with independent parity
freeze native timeframe alignment under Darwinex/source clock
execute independent real-data event-mask parity on canonical DEV bytes
